## Type of change

- [ ] New extension

## Checklist

- [ ] The new or changed API has a `///` doc comment with a usage example
- [ ] There is a test, and `swift test` and the iOS simulator tests pass
- [ ] `xcrun swift-format lint --strict --recursive Sources Tests` is clean
- [ ] New UI supports Dynamic Type, VoiceOver and Reduce Motion
- [ ] No new third-party dependency
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under **Unreleased**
